ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; the surface is predominantly comprised of low-intensity (black) pixels with sparse, localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters and linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The surface presents as a nearly uniform solid low-intensity field. High-contrast contiguous blobs are located exclusively at the distal tips (barnacle colonies) and as fine-grained, high-contrast stippling and linear disruptions distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression; calculated interior angle of approximately 145 degrees with minimal depth relative to the fluke's vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The boundary displays high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. A distinct high-amplitude irregular indentation is visible on the trailing edge of the left lobe (viewer perspective), approximately midway between the notch and the tip. The distal right lobe trailing edge exhibits significant jaggedness.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves sweeping posteriorly and laterally from the median notch towards the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of roughly circular white pixels at both lateral tips. Multiple isolated, small-diameter white circular points are scattered across the ventral plane.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive multi-directional linear pixel disruptions. A high-density cluster of parallel rake marks is located on the right lobe (viewer perspective), with individual scattered linear marks visible on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization at both distal tips. Extensive rake-mark scarring on the right lobe. A deep, irregular notch or missing tissue section on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific pattern of parallel rake marks on the right lobe combined with the deep singular notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe serves as a unique pixel-level signature.
